app.name: IAM Assistant
app.description: Overview of IAM groups and users; build and test IAM policies and boundaries.

scopes.name: storage:smartscape:read
scopes.comment: IAM tabs: condition value suggestions (Smartscape node fields, process groups, ActiveGate groups)

scopes.name: storage:metrics:read
scopes.comment: IAM tabs: condition value suggestions (metric keys and dimensions)

scopes.name: storage:logs:read
scopes.comment: IAM tabs: condition value suggestions (sampled logs); Permissions Test: readable records preview

scopes.name: storage:events:read
scopes.comment: IAM tabs: condition value suggestions (event.kind / event.type / event.provider)

scopes.name: storage:bizevents:read
scopes.comment: IAM tabs: condition value suggestions (business events)

scopes.name: storage:spans:read
scopes.comment: IAM tabs: condition value suggestions (sampled spans); Permissions Test: readable records preview

scopes.name: storage:buckets:read
scopes.comment: IAM tabs: read the Grail buckets behind the value suggestion queries

scopes.name: storage:bucket-definitions:read
scopes.comment: IAM tabs: list Grail buckets and their tables (dt.system.buckets), for storage:bucket-name / storage:table-name values

scopes.name: storage:entities:read
scopes.comment: IAM tabs: classic entity IDs and names (process groups, hosts, host groups) for condition values

scopes.name: storage:system:read
scopes.comment: IAM tabs: entity types (dt.system.data_objects) and system events for condition values

scopes.name: settings:objects:read
scopes.comment: IAM tabs: management zone names for environment:management-zone values

scopes.name: settings:schemas:read
scopes.comment: IAM tabs: list settings schemas and read a schema definition (schema groups), for settings:schemaId / settings:schemaGroup values

scopes.name: extensions:definitions:read
scopes.comment: IAM tabs: extension names for extensions:extension-name values

scopes.name: app-engine:apps:run
scopes.comment: IAM tabs: list installed apps and the scopes their manifests request (App Registry), for shared:app-id values

scopes.name: iam:users:read
scopes.comment: Permissions Test: find users by name or email (environment IAM API)

scopes.name: iam:groups:read
scopes.comment: Permissions Test: find groups by name (environment IAM API)

scopes.name: app-settings:objects:read
scopes.comment: App credentials: the app functions read the app-credentials settings object (the secret comes back in plain text only to the app's functions); the UI shows whether it is set

scopes.name: app-settings:objects:write
scopes.comment: App credentials: admins store the account OAuth client in the app-credentials settings object; also checked (effective permissions) to decide who may change it
